item.title: Texas Tech blows through Iowa State in statement win
item.description: No. 16 Texas Tech hit the road Saturday for one of its final regular season tests. Despite being shorthanded, the Red Raiders dominated No. 4 Iowa State from the opening tip and held off the Cyclones late for a 82-73 victory.
